# GameHaven

> Indie game marketplace demo: a Vue 3 storefront with an offline catalog, cart and library, backed by a .NET 10 Clean Architecture solution migrated from a legacy WPF desktop app.

- [Live demo](https://gamehaven.naindev.com/): interactive catalog, client-side cart and library
- [Source code](https://github.com/Nain9Dev/GameHaven): domain, API, Vue client, architecture tests and migration case study
- [NainDev](https://www.naindev.com/): the author's main site and project ecosystem
